meta.title: Crownicles - A Multiplayer Role-Play Game for Discord
meta.description: Join the Crownicles adventure on Discord! Explore a medieval world, battle monsters, complete quests, and win the kingdom's princess's hand in this immersive multiplayer RPG.

game.welcomeText: You have just arrived in the kingdom. The roads are long and full of surprises — random encounters await at every turn. Let's see what lies ahead...
game.finalText: You've had a taste of what Crownicles has to offer. Join thousands of players on Discord and write your own story!
game.teaserText: This is just a glimpse of the countless encounters that await you in Crownicles. Join the adventure on Discord to find out what happens next!

events.text: As you pass a lake, you notice a man who seems to be having difficulties on his fishing trip!

choices.label: Offer your help.
choices.outcome: Thanks to you, the man catches a superb fish weighing in at 3 kg! To thank you, he offers you something that could be useful to you...

choices.label: Push the fisherman into the water!
choices.outcome: But why did you do it? Feeling remorseful, you help the poor man and offer him a few coins to make up for it.

choices.label: Keep going, no time to waste!
choices.outcome: You don't have even a minute to lose to help a fisherman! You go your way.

events.text: After spending several weeks walking without any human encounter, you finally enter a small town that seems rather lively.

choices.label: Go to the forge.
choices.outcome: No one is in the forge, which seems to have been abandoned for years. Before leaving, however, you notice an object that could be useful for the rest of your adventure...

choices.label: Go to the inn.
choices.outcome: You pay for a room for the night and fall down on the bed. You will need to sleep before resuming the adventure.

choices.label: Go to the market.
choices.outcome: You explore the market for 30 minutes before discovering a small object on the ground that could be useful to you...
